meta.title: Reassign Line Item: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Set or verify that the current tenant is on a plan below Growth or on Growth.
Observe whether the Reassign Line Item capability is absent or refused on the lower plan.
Perform Reassign Line Item to another user and verify it succeeds on Growth.
Repeat the same reassignment comparison across the two plan contexts.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set or verify that the current tenant is on a plan below Growth or on Growth.; Observe whether the Reassign Line Item capability is absent or refused on the lower plan.; Perform Reassign Line Item to another user and verify it succeeds on Growth.; Repeat the same reassignment comparison across the two plan contexts.

steps.note: Navigate to the purchase requisitions workflow relevant to reassignment.
Use open purchase requisitions, since only open PRs can proceed through the catalog flow.
Select an available PR so its line items and subsequent actions become available.

args.need: provide a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant for the same Procurement Manager, then verify Reassign Line Item is unavailable or refused on the lower plan and reassign a PR line item to another user successfully on Growth

steps.note: Tenant plan setup, the Reassign Line Item control/action, and the cross-plan comparison are not expressible by catalog steps.
Assert that the current screen remains usable after the requested manual comparison.
